title: Cohomology properties of maps in (Cat) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is proving the theorem stated on the previous page, 'L'ens W est saturé'. Here W is the class of weak equivalences in Cat, or in a presheaf category A^ through i_A. Saturated means that a functor f whose image γ(f) in the localisation W^{-1}Cat is an isomorphism already lies in W. This page carries out the proof.

Step 0. Let f = f_0 : X_0 → X_1 with γ(f_0) an isomorphism. 'OPS' (on peut supposer, one may assume) that f_0 is an open immersion, i.e. a cosieve inclusion. This uses a factorisation f = p∘j with j an open immersion and p ∈ W, together with 2-out-of-3.

Step 1. The previous page established a calculus-of-fractions type property for γ. By it there is f_1 : X_1 → X_2 with f_1 f_0 ∈ W. Then γ(f_1)γ(f_0) = γ(f_1 f_0) is an isomorphism, so γ(f_1) is an isomorphism. Again one may factor f_1 and assume it is an open immersion; 2-out-of-3 keeps f_1 f_0 ∈ W.

Step 2. Iterating gives a sequence X_0 → X_1 → X_2 → ... of open immersions in which each composite of two consecutive maps, f_{n+1}f_n, lies in W. Let X_∞ = lim→ X_n, with canonical maps i_n : X_n → X_∞, so that i_1 f_0 = i_0.

Step 3. By 2-out-of-3 it suffices to show i_0, i_1 ∈ W. By symmetry it is enough to treat i_0: shift the sequence by one, replacing f_0 by f_1, to get i_1.

Step 4. X_∞ is also the colimit of the cofinal even subsequence X_0 → X_2 → X_4 → ..., whose transition maps f_{2n+1}f_{2n} are in W. So all the maps X_0 → X_{2n} are in W, being composites of W-maps. The lemma on the previous page ('L 3') says W is stable under filtered unions or colimits of open immersions. Hence i_0, the colimit of the i_0^{2n}, is in W. 'donc on gagne !!'

The point is a telescope or cofinality trick. One has only the weak '2-out-of-6-like' data 'each pair of consecutive composites is in W'. The trick turns it into honest membership in W by passing to a colimit along open immersions, where W is known to be stable.
errors: The argument relies on two things established elsewhere: (i) a calculus of fractions, or at least the existence of a right inverse up to W, for W in Cat; (ii) stability of W under countable colimits of chains of open immersions in W. Both are taken from the previous pages and not reproved here.

Choosing f_n to be open immersions needs a factorisation of any functor as an open immersion followed by a map in W, plus a 2-out-of-3 check that f_{n+1}f_n ∈ W survives the replacement. This is only indicated ('quitte à factoriser').

The sentence 'il suffit ... l'un ou l'autre' is loose. Both i_0 and i_1 are needed for 2-out-of-3; the remark only means that the second case follows from the first by an index shift, which the text itself then says.

ideas.what: Saturation of the class W of weak equivalences in Cat (or of W_A in presheaf categories): γ(f) iso implies f ∈ W
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Pursuing Stacks / Les Dérivateurs framework); general proof that every fundamental localizer is strongly saturated is due to Cisinski (Astérisque 308, 2006); expounded by Maltsiniotis (Astérisque 301)
ideas.where_published: Saturation of localizers is discussed in Pursuing Stacks and Les Dérivateurs; this specific proof: unsure

ideas.what: Telescope trick: from a chain with consecutive composites in W, pass to the colimit and use the cofinal even subsequence to put the structure maps in W
ideas.modern_name: cofinality / telescope argument; related to 2-out-of-6 implying saturation (Dwyer–Hirschhorn–Kan–Smith)
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore; 2-out-of-6 and saturation in homotopical categories: Dwyer–Hirschhorn–Kan–Smith (2004)

ideas.what: Stability of W under filtered colimits of open immersions (cosieves)
ideas.modern_name: stability of weak equivalences under filtered colimits / transfinite composites of cofibrations
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard for Thomason weak equivalences; for fundamental localizers, Cisinski

missed.claim: A short, self-contained proof of saturation of W, assuming a fraction calculus and filtered-colimit stability. It works by a telescope along open immersions and the cofinal even subsequence, without model-category machinery. This is a pleasant elementary argument, but saturation itself is known (Cisinski), and similar telescope arguments are folklore.
missed.quote: et aussi X_∞ = lim→_n (X_0 → X_2 → X_4 → … → X_{2n} → …) et i_0 est limite des i_0^{2n} : X_0 → X_{2n}, qui sont ∈ W, donc on gagne !!
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It gives a minimal-axiom route to saturation for classes of weak equivalences that are stable under filtered colimits of 'cofibrations' (e.g. in ∞-cosmos-like or localizer settings). Its historical interest is limited.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a neat, complete proof of a known result: the saturation of fundamental localizers, proved in general by Cisinski. The telescope trick is elegant but close to folklore and to the 2-out-of-6 saturation arguments; a specialist would recognise it.
transcription_corrections: Line 6 is better read as 'OPS [f_1 imm. ouverte], quitte à factoriser g par immersion ouverte' rather than 'OPS pareil : factorisons g'.
'il suffit de prouver que i_0 et i_1, [il suffit] bien sûr de l'un des deux ... soient ∈ W' (reading uncertain); the bracketed 'Il suffit' is an insertion.
